title: Paul McCartney live: T-Mobile Park, Prague | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the T-Mobile Park (Park Kolbenova) in Prague, Czech Republic, on 6 June 2004.

It was the sixth show of the 04 Summer Tour, which lasted for 14 dates in May and June 2004.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
